name: hilo_comments
description: Widget assets for Hilo (self-hosted comments) — embed.js, embed.css, and themes/*.css. Source here is plain, readable JS/CSS; `npm run build` minifies it into dist/, which is what actually gets published.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/themes && esbuild embed.js --minify --outfile=dist/embed.js && esbuild embed.css --minify --outfile=dist/embed.css && esbuild themes/*.css --minify --outdir=dist/themes && cp package.json dist/package.json
scripts.release: npm run build && cd dist && npm publish --access public
